blocks.explanation:
Ghaur karein: 8, 7, 6, 5 lagatar (consecutive) numbers hain jo ek ek kam ho rahe hain.
Find kya karna hai? Isi number ko factorials ki shakal mein likhna hai.
Plan: product ko 1 tak poora karne ke liye upar aur neeche \(4!\) se multiply karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6 \cdot 5\)
Humein find karna hai: factorial form.
Tareeqa: Lagatar (consecutive) numbers ka product jo \(a\) se shuru ho kar \(b\) par ruk jaye, woh \(\dfrac{a!}{(b - 1)!}\) hota hai. Yani jo numbers 1 tak pohanchne ke liye kam hain, unhein upar aur neeche dono jagah multiply kar do; upar poora factorial ban jata hai aur neeche ek chhota factorial.

Upar neeche \(4!\) se multiply karein
\[8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6 \cdot 5 = \dfrac{8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6 \cdot 5 \cdot 4!}{4!}\]
Kyun: Kisi cheez ko ek hi number se multiply aur divide karne se us ki value nahi badalti. \(4! = 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1\) woh numbers de deta hai jo 8 se 1 tak pohanchne ke liye kam the.

Upar factorial pehchanein
\[= \dfrac{8!}{4!}\]
Kyun: Ab upar \(8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6 \cdot 5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1\) hai jo bilkul \(8!\) hai.
Dhyan dein: Neeche \(4!\) aata hai, \(5!\) nahi. Product 5 par ruka hai, aur 5 khud upar mojood hai; neeche sirf 4 se 1 tak ke numbers jaate hain.

Tasdeeq
\[8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6 \cdot 5 = 1680\]
\[\dfrac{40320}{24} = 1680 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(8! = 40320\) aur \(4! = 24\); divide kiya to wohi 1680 aaya jo seedha multiply karne se aata hai.

blocks.explanation:
15 se 11 tak lagatar numbers ka product hai.
Plan: 11 ke baad agla number 10 hai, is liye upar neeche \(10!\) lagayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(15 \cdot 14 \cdot 13 \cdot 12 \cdot 11\)
Humein find karna hai: factorial form.
Tareeqa: Lagatar (consecutive) numbers ka product jo \(a\) se shuru ho kar \(b\) par ruk jaye, woh \(\dfrac{a!}{(b - 1)!}\) hota hai. Yani jo numbers 1 tak pohanchne ke liye kam hain, unhein upar aur neeche dono jagah multiply kar do; upar poora factorial ban jata hai aur neeche ek chhota factorial.

Upar neeche \(10!\) se multiply karein
\[= \dfrac{15 \cdot 14 \cdot 13 \cdot 12 \cdot 11 \cdot 10!}{10!}\]
Kyun: Product 11 par ruk gaya, yani 10 se 1 tak ke numbers ghaib hain. Woh sab mil kar \(10!\) hain, isi liye \(10!\) se multiply aur divide kiya.

Upar factorial likhein
\[= \dfrac{15!}{10!}\]
Kyun: Ab upar 15 se 1 tak sab numbers hain, jo \(15!\) hai.

Tasdeeq
\[15 \cdot 14 \cdot 13 \cdot 12 \cdot 11 = 360360\]
\[\dfrac{15!}{10!} = 360360 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono shakalon ki value ek hai. Aik aasaan check: \(15 - 10 = 5\), aur product mein bhi 5 hi factors hain.

blocks.explanation:
19 se 16 tak lagatar numbers hain.
Plan: 16 ke baad agla 15 hai, to \(15!\) istemal karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(19 \cdot 18 \cdot 17 \cdot 16\)
Humein find karna hai: factorial form.
Tareeqa: Lagatar (consecutive) numbers ka product jo \(a\) se shuru ho kar \(b\) par ruk jaye, woh \(\dfrac{a!}{(b - 1)!}\) hota hai. Yani jo numbers 1 tak pohanchne ke liye kam hain, unhein upar aur neeche dono jagah multiply kar do; upar poora factorial ban jata hai aur neeche ek chhota factorial.

Upar neeche \(15!\) se multiply karein
\[= \dfrac{19 \cdot 18 \cdot 17 \cdot 16 \cdot 15!}{15!}\]
Kyun: 15 se 1 tak ke numbers ghaib the; \(15!\) unhein poora kar deta hai aur value wohi rehti hai.

Upar factorial likhein
\[= \dfrac{19!}{15!}\]
Kyun: Upar ab 19 se 1 tak ka product hai, yani \(19!\).

Tasdeeq
\[19 \cdot 18 \cdot 17 \cdot 16 = 93024\]
\[\dfrac{19!}{15!} = 93024 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Value ek jaisi aayi. Ginti ka check bhi: \(19 - 15 = 4\) factors, aur product mein 4 hi numbers hain.

blocks.explanation:
Yahan upar bhi lagatar numbers hain aur neeche bhi.
Plan: upar aur neeche ko alag alag factorial form mein likhein, phir dono ko jor dein. Bara sawal chhote hisson mein tor kar aasaan ho jata hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\dfrac{11 \cdot 10 \cdot 9 \cdot 8 \cdot 7}{5 \cdot 4}\)
Humein find karna hai: factorial form.
Tareeqa: Lagatar (consecutive) numbers ka product jo \(a\) se shuru ho kar \(b\) par ruk jaye, woh \(\dfrac{a!}{(b - 1)!}\) hota hai. Yani jo numbers 1 tak pohanchne ke liye kam hain, unhein upar aur neeche dono jagah multiply kar do; upar poora factorial ban jata hai aur neeche ek chhota factorial.

Upar wala hissa
\[11 \cdot 10 \cdot 9 \cdot 8 \cdot 7 = \dfrac{11!}{6!}\]
Kyun: Upar ka product 7 par ruka hai, to 6 se 1 tak ghaib hain, yani \(6!\).

Neeche wala hissa
\[5 \cdot 4 = \dfrac{5!}{3!}\]
Kyun: Neeche ka product 4 par ruka hai, to 3 se 1 tak ghaib hain, yani \(3!\). Check: \(\dfrac{120}{6} = 20 = 5 \cdot 4\).

Divide karein
\[\dfrac{11!/6!}{5!/3!} = \dfrac{11!\,3!}{6!\,5!}\]
Kyun: Fraction se divide karna us ke ulte (reciprocal) se multiply karna hai. Is liye neeche wale fraction ka \(3!\) upar aa gaya aur \(5!\) neeche chala gaya.
Dhyan dein: \(3!\) ko neeche likh dena aam ghalti hai; 'fraction ka fraction' mein neeche wale fraction ka denominator upar jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{55440}{20} = 2772\]
\[\dfrac{11! \cdot 6}{720 \cdot 120} = 2772 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Asal sawal \(\dfrac{55440}{20} = 2772\) deta hai, aur hamari factorial shakal bhi 2772. Dono barabar.

blocks.explanation: Neeche to pehle hi poora \(5!\) hai. Plan: sirf upar ko factorial form mein likhna hai, phir jorna hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\dfrac{10 \cdot 9 \cdot 8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6}{5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1}\)
Humein find karna hai: factorial form.
Tareeqa: Lagatar (consecutive) numbers ka product jo \(a\) se shuru ho kar \(b\) par ruk jaye, woh \(\dfrac{a!}{(b - 1)!}\) hota hai. Yani jo numbers 1 tak pohanchne ke liye kam hain, unhein upar aur neeche dono jagah multiply kar do; upar poora factorial ban jata hai aur neeche ek chhota factorial.

Upar aur neeche likhein
\[10 \cdot 9 \cdot 8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6 = \dfrac{10!}{5!}\]
\[5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1 = 5!\]
Kyun: Upar ka product 6 par ruka, to 5 se 1 tak ghaib hain, yani \(5!\). Neeche 5 se 1 tak sab mojood hain, to woh khud \(5!\) hai.

Jorein
\[\dfrac{10!/5!}{5!} = \dfrac{10!}{5!\,5!}\]
Kyun: Pehle se neeche ek \(5!\) tha, ab doosra bhi neeche aa gaya, is liye neeche \(5!\,5!\) hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{30240}{120} = 252\]
\[\dfrac{3628800}{120 \cdot 120} = 252 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Asal sawal aur factorial shakal dono 252 dete hain. Yeh \({}^{10}C_5\) bhi hai, jo aap combination mein dekhenge.

blocks.explanation: Neeche \(5!\) hai aur upar 50 se 47 tak lagatar numbers. Plan: bilkul part (v) wala tareeqa.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\dfrac{50 \cdot 49 \cdot 48 \cdot 47}{5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1}\)
Humein find karna hai: factorial form.
Tareeqa: Lagatar (consecutive) numbers ka product jo \(a\) se shuru ho kar \(b\) par ruk jaye, woh \(\dfrac{a!}{(b - 1)!}\) hota hai. Yani jo numbers 1 tak pohanchne ke liye kam hain, unhein upar aur neeche dono jagah multiply kar do; upar poora factorial ban jata hai aur neeche ek chhota factorial.

Upar aur neeche likhein
\[50 \cdot 49 \cdot 48 \cdot 47 = \dfrac{50!}{46!}\]
\[5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1 = 5!\]
Kyun: Upar ka product 47 par ruka, to 46 se 1 tak ghaib hain, yani \(46!\).

Jorein
\[= \dfrac{50!}{5!\,46!}\]
Kyun: \(46!\) aur \(5!\) dono neeche aa gaye. Bari values ko kabhi poora multiply karne ki zaroorat nahi; factorial form isi liye kaam ki cheez hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{5527200}{120} = 46060\]
\[\dfrac{50!}{5!\,46!} = 46060 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Asal sawal 46060 deta hai aur factorial shakal (exact calculation se) bhi 46060.

blocks.explanation:
Ab numbers ki jagah \(n\) hai, lekin idea wohi hai: har factor pichle se ek kam.
Plan: \(n - 3\) ke baad agla factor \(n - 4\) hai, to \((n - 4)!\) se upar neeche multiply karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(n(n - 1)(n - 2)(n - 3)\)
Humein find karna hai: factorial form.
Tareeqa: Lagatar (consecutive) numbers ka product jo \(a\) se shuru ho kar \(b\) par ruk jaye, woh \(\dfrac{a!}{(b - 1)!}\) hota hai. Yani jo numbers 1 tak pohanchne ke liye kam hain, unhein upar aur neeche dono jagah multiply kar do; upar poora factorial ban jata hai aur neeche ek chhota factorial.

Upar neeche \((n - 4)!\) se multiply karein
\[= \dfrac{n(n - 1)(n - 2)(n - 3)(n - 4)!}{(n - 4)!}\]
Kyun: Product \(n - 3\) par ruka hai. Is ke baad \((n - 4)(n - 5) \cdots 1\) ghaib hain, jo mil kar \((n - 4)!\) bante hain.

Upar factorial likhein
\[= \dfrac{n!}{(n - 4)!}\]
Kyun: Upar ab \(n\) se 1 tak sab factors hain, yani \(n!\).

Tasdeeq: ek number rakh kar
\[n = 6:\ 6 \cdot 5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3 = 360\]
\[\dfrac{6!}{2!} = \dfrac{720}{2} = 360 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Algebra wale jawab ko check karne ka sab se aasaan tareeqa: \(n\) ki jagah koi number rakh kar dono taraf ki value dekhein. Dono 360.

blocks.explanation:
Yahan factors \(n + 2\) se shuru ho kar \(n - 1\) tak lagatar ghat rahe hain.
Plan: \(n - 1\) ke baad agla \(n - 2\) hai, to \((n - 2)!\) lagayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \((n + 2)(n + 1)n(n - 1)\)
Humein find karna hai: factorial form.
Tareeqa: Lagatar (consecutive) numbers ka product jo \(a\) se shuru ho kar \(b\) par ruk jaye, woh \(\dfrac{a!}{(b - 1)!}\) hota hai. Yani jo numbers 1 tak pohanchne ke liye kam hain, unhein upar aur neeche dono jagah multiply kar do; upar poora factorial ban jata hai aur neeche ek chhota factorial.

Upar neeche \((n - 2)!\) se multiply karein
\[= \dfrac{(n + 2)(n + 1)n(n - 1)(n - 2)!}{(n - 2)!}\]
Kyun: \(n - 1\) ke neeche ke saare factors \((n - 2)(n - 3) \cdots 1 = (n - 2)!\) ghaib the.

Upar factorial likhein
\[= \dfrac{(n + 2)!}{(n - 2)!}\]
Kyun: Upar ab sab se bara factor \(n + 2\) hai aur product 1 tak jata hai, to yeh \((n + 2)!\) hai.
Dhyan dein: Upar \(n!\) nahi, \((n + 2)!\) likhna hai, kyunke product \(n + 2\) se shuru ho raha hai.

Tasdeeq: ek number rakh kar
\[n = 3:\ 5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 = 120\]
\[\dfrac{5!}{1!} = 120 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(n = 3\) rakhne se dono taraf 120 aaya.

blocks.explanation: Upar \(n + 3\) se \(n\) tak lagatar factors hain aur neeche \(5!\). Plan: upar ko part (vii) ki tarah likhein, phir \(5!\) se divide karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\dfrac{(n + 3)(n + 2)(n + 1)n}{5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1}\)
Humein find karna hai: factorial form.
Tareeqa: Lagatar (consecutive) numbers ka product jo \(a\) se shuru ho kar \(b\) par ruk jaye, woh \(\dfrac{a!}{(b - 1)!}\) hota hai. Yani jo numbers 1 tak pohanchne ke liye kam hain, unhein upar aur neeche dono jagah multiply kar do; upar poora factorial ban jata hai aur neeche ek chhota factorial.

Upar wala hissa
\[(n + 3)(n + 2)(n + 1)n = \dfrac{(n + 3)!}{(n - 1)!}\]
Kyun: Product \(n\) par ruka hai, to \(n - 1\) se 1 tak ghaib hain, yani \((n - 1)!\).

Neeche wale se divide karein
\[\dfrac{(n + 3)!}{(n - 1)!\,5!}\]
Kyun: \(5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1 = 5!\), aur yeh bhi neeche \((n - 1)!\) ke saath aa gaya.

Tasdeeq: ek number rakh kar
\[n = 2:\ \dfrac{5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2}{120} = 1\]
\[\dfrac{5!}{1!\,5!} = 1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(n = 2\) par dono taraf 1 aaya, is liye shakal sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (x) Write in the factorial form: \(n(n - 1)(n - 2) \ldots (n - r + 2)\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh sab se mushkil lagta hai, lekin tareeqa wohi hai: \(n\) se shuru ho kar \(n - r + 2\) tak lagatar factors.
Plan: aakhri factor se ek kam karein, \(n - r + 1\) milega; isi ka factorial neeche aayega.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(n(n - 1)(n - 2) \cdots (n - r + 2)\)
Humein find karna hai: factorial form.
Tareeqa: Lagatar (consecutive) numbers ka product jo \(a\) se shuru ho kar \(b\) par ruk jaye, woh \(\dfrac{a!}{(b - 1)!}\) hota hai. Yani jo numbers 1 tak pohanchne ke liye kam hain, unhein upar aur neeche dono jagah multiply kar do; upar poora factorial ban jata hai aur neeche ek chhota factorial.

Ghaib hissa pehchanein
\[(n - r + 2) - 1 = n - r + 1\]
Kyun: Har factor pichle se ek kam hai. Aakhri factor \(n - r + 2\) hai, to pehla ghaib factor \(n - r + 1\) hai, aur us se 1 tak sab mil kar \((n - r + 1)!\) bante hain.

Upar neeche \((n - r + 1)!\) se multiply karein
\[= \dfrac{n(n - 1) \cdots (n - r + 2)(n - r + 1)!}{(n - r + 1)!}\]
\[= \dfrac{n!}{(n - r + 1)!}\]
Kyun: Upar ab \(n\) se 1 tak sab factors hain, yani \(n!\).
Dhyan dein: Bohat se students neeche \((n - r)!\) likh dete hain. Woh tab hota jab product \(n - r + 1\) tak jata. Yahan product \(n - r + 2\) par ruk raha hai, is liye neeche \((n - r + 1)!\) hai.

Tasdeeq: numbers rakh kar
\[n = 6,\ r = 3:\ 6 \cdot 5 = 30\]
\[\dfrac{6!}{4!} = 30 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(n = 6\), \(r = 3\) par aakhri factor \(n - r + 2 = 5\) hai, to product \(6 \cdot 5 = 30\). Formula se bhi 30. Is product mein \(r - 1\) factors hain, is liye yeh \({}^{n}P_{r-1}\) ke barabar hai.
